reviews.title: I love the new levels😁 But the timers are really annoying.
reviews.text: So I haven’t been active on BrainSpot for months. However, I recently started being active again, and I was so surprised to see that nearly every single game has exactly 1,000 levels. I couldn’t believe it! Each game had an average of 100-150 levels but now there are 1,000 levels. Which is a good thing because I finished all the levels of some of the games before the 1,000 level update. Now I’m happy that I can play more levels. The two things I don’t like is that I can’t go back to previous levels that I completed, which is very frustrating😠, other frustrating thing is the timers. Like why would you add timers to the games where you have to finish 5 puzzles before finishing the level. This is just very frustrating. Please remove the timers, they are so annoying especially when you run out of time. But I’m still giving BrainSpot 5 stars even though the timers are annoying, the new games made me give 5 stars still😊.

reviews.title: Absolutely Stellar customer service
reviews.text:
TLDR: Great app; Best customer service I have had in a VERY long time.

First, I really like this app. I have been playing it since last year and have greatly enjoyed the variety of puzzles and brain teasers. I have other apps for “brain training” as well, but this one seems to have a wider variety of skills needed than some of the others, so my brain is getting a thorough workout by the end of the day.

I recently had an odd issue with my lifetime paid account that was probably my own fault. I purchased it back in Oct. 2024, It is almost May 2025 as I write this, and I have never had an issue with it that I can recall until very recently. I contacted customer support and although it took several emails and a lot of back and forth, they were extremely courteous and patient and have ultimately resolved the issue. 

It has been rare for me to receive the type of support for an app as I did with this one.  They responded to my initial inquiry as well as each subsequent one within a few hours; and kept digging through the complicated issue until they found the information required to restore the account. I could not be happier.

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: This is by far one of the best games I’ve ever downloaded. I’d say to get the full potential you’ll have to get the premium version but honestly with how much you could do paying $30 for a lifetime access isn’t bad. At first i thought it would be like these other games just filled with ads every two levels but when i continued to play i realized that this app is actually designed by people who really want to help others. I honestly recommend this game to anyone who would like to exercise their brain in a fun way. You’d think the levels are easy but honestly the more you go the more you have to sit and think. Very great app!

reviews.title: 2 mins?!
reviews.text: Okay, this is a good game,  but right after 2 minutes, something popped up on my screen and it said that my time today was finished. Like what? I know tomorrow I will have another 2 mins. I don't recommend this game for people that don't want a very short time on it in one day. It's really fun and I really like this game, but this game has a short time to play, so just take out the timer or make the timer long, (at least 10-15 mins). Then I do recommend this game.

reviews.title: Used to be a good app
reviews.text:
Up until recently energy was capped at 12 (now 10) and all puzzle types were playable. Now theyve made it more about making money (understandable) and you can only play like 1 in every 7 puzzles free. Its annoying that the company took away functionality.

Thus used to be a 5 star app that I played religiously everyday.

UPDATE: to dev response: you said nothing. Im disappointed to say after playing so long and reaching mastermind level that its time to delete. Just too many levels have become blocked that previously were accessible.
